name: NBHD Cron Enforcement
description: Fire-time OUTBOUND enforcement for typed cron patterns. Observes cron_changed to cache a firing cron's baked nbhd.v1 contract by jobId, joins runId to jobId at before_prompt_build, then evaluates every dispatched nbhd_send_to_user call at before_tool_call — pass, rewrite to safe content, or block-and-revise (bounded) — before the message ever leaves the container. The same run seam signs provenance for cron/datebook create tools. Zero Django calls at fire time. Registers no tools.

cacheTtlSeconds.description: How long a cached firing-session contract lives before forced expiry. Default 600s.

tenantId.description: Override tenant ID. Defaults to NBHD_TENANT_ID env var.

internalApiKey.description: Override internal API key. Defaults to NBHD_INTERNAL_API_KEY env var.
